## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed 402 image captures during February 2020. This activity provides the operational basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the number of results requiring referral.

## Image quality

Of the 402 captures, 5 were recorded as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.2. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality during routine operations and ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Consistent recording of equipment concerns will support follow-up and help identify any continuing effect on image assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 59 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. These results should be reviewed as part of the clinic’s normal quality and service monitoring arrangements. The activity, image-quality findings and grading results together provide a concise view of performance at North City Eye Clinic during February 2020.
